sections.title: Claude Opus 4.6 Discovers 22 Firefox Security Vulnerabilities in Two Weeks
sections.lead: Anthropic's Claude Opus 4.6 discovered 22 new security vulnerabilities in Firefox during February 1-14 through collaboration with Mozilla, with 14 classified as high-risk CVEs and most patched by early March in Firefox 148.
